This guide changes organisation-wide configuration. The run created only types, Statuses, Fields, Document types and Officer roles named "DOC-032 records V-C38 ... 0928074931", reordered only its own rows, set the colour it changed back to Automatic, only opened and closed the colour swatch of the seeded Partially signed type, and archived everything it created at the end (cleanup record in walkthrough.json). A fixture Matter, Contract and Entity with Officers were created through the API to hold values.
scenarios.expected: New and existing records reflect the documented configuration and retained-value behavior. Immutable Stage/Category mappings and invalid reassignment are refused; non-Administrators cannot edit configuration.
scenarios.actual: 38 recorded browser steps passed for this role (run 0928074931, last step 2026-09-28T07:51:30.418Z). Profile menu > Settings > Organization > Matters > Types: Add type + Save added the fixture types and Cancel left no row; Rename, Edit (Details and Form tabs, Description saved on leaving the field) and keyboard reorder (own row above own row) persisted. Contracts, Entities and Knowledge each took Add type; Edit exists on Contracts and Entities, not Knowledge. Archiving an in-use type showed its usage count and offered only live types other than itself; the Matter moved to the replacement; Other shows the lock; the Default row shows Archive but the dialog refused with "Default is the Default type and cannot be archived or deleted: module-only Requests need its Form."; the Create matter dialog preselected Default; Show archived > Restore did not move the Matter back; the API refused reassignment onto an archived type or the type itself (400). Documents: the Matters, Contracts and Entities tabs; Add type, Rename and reorder on Matters; the swatch "Colour for <name>" opened Automatic, Grey, Blue, Amber, Green, Red, Orange and Purple, Purple saved at once (PATCH 200) and read "Colour for ...: Purple" after a reload, and Automatic set it back. The Contracts list shows the seven fixed types in the order Draft · ours, Draft · theirs, Redline · theirs, Redline · ours, Partially signed, Executed, Amendment, each with the lock "<name> has a fixed name. Its colour can be changed.", a colour swatch and no Rename or Archive; the Partially signed swatch opened with enabled choices and Escape changed nothing. On Entities the upload dialog showed a Type choice only with a live type; archive asked for no replacement and the archived type left the upload choices. Contract Statuses: Add status with a Stage, Cancel, Save status, Rename and reorder; the row has no Stage control; Draft, Partially signed, Active and Expired show "<name> is system-protected and can't be archived"; the in-use Terminated dialog asks you to move Contracts and has no replacement; a fixture Signature Status archived while the seeded Signature Statuses stayed live. Matter Statuses: Open with default group In progress, Waiting, Closed with no group; the row group control saved Open; archiving an in-use custom Status offered only Open-Category replacements and moved the Matter. The API refused a Stage or Category change (400). Fields: Default Fields collapsed with locked rows, Custom Fields expanded; Governing law, Jurisdiction and Our position show "<name> is a default Field and can't be archived" and the API refuses; Add field with the Type list of the guide, Options one per line, no Type control after creation, no reorder handles; AI prompt and Answer style (Organisation default) on Contract Text Fields. Form: Attach Field with Search fields, Create Field, the three switches with Saved and Touchpoint Intake/Creation/Record, Visible on Portal locked on while On intake form is on, keyboard move with Title and Type pinned; a Branch with Add condition, Put under a condition..., Preview intake form (Fixed shows Expiry date as required, Evergreen hides it), AND/OR join, Remove condition; a new Contract required the Creation Row. Archive in the Field catalog hid the Row and kept the stored value, Restore brought it back, and Detach kept the Field. Entity Forms show only Required for creation. Officer roles: Add role, Rename, reorder, archive with replacement counting current and resigned Officers, Restore without moving them back. Nadia Haddad saw no Organization configuration: the four configuration URLs showed no add controls and POST /api/v1/contract-types answered 403.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough in headless Chromium (Playwright 1.63.0) by a different agent from the author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The author's product bug (archiving the last other Signature Status shows no warning in Settings but the API refuses) was not reproduced. It needs Partially signed plus only one other live Signature Status; on the shared lab that means archiving the seeded Out for signature and Signed, awaiting countersignature, which other guides rely on. A fixture Signature Status archived normally while those stayed live.

The guide says the Matters and Entities Document type lists start empty. On the shared lab they held other agents' fixture rows, so the empty start could not be seen; the upload-dialog rule was checked on the Entities list.

The colour of a seeded fixed Contract type was not changed, to protect other guides on the shared lab: its swatch opened with enabled choices and was closed with Escape. The saved-colour behaviour was checked on this run's own Document type.
Stage or Category changes have no control on either page, so the refusal was checked through the API as the Administrator.
Author limitation confirmed: the Settings pane labels the control Colour ("Colour for <name>").
